name: HeyGen Avatar Realtime API
desc: Broadcast API that turns a HeyGen avatar into a live streaming agent
desc_zh: 把 HeyGen 数字人变成实时直播 Agent 的广播接口
solves: Pre-rendered avatars force you to write, render and publish before anyone can watch. It answers live, so the avatar takes input while the stream runs.
solves_zh: 预渲染的数字人要先写脚本、渲染、发布，观众才能看到。它当场接住实时输入，直播中就能作答。
best_for: When a product demo needs an avatar that answers questions from the audience as they arrive.
best_for_zh: 产品演示需要数字人当场回答观众提问的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — HeyGen blog monthly release roundups (heygen.com/blog), "What's new at HeyGe）。 Listed in the June roundup under the heading "Avatar Realtime API (Broadcast)". Only the month is documented; the roundup is the first-party page. Reaches developers through the HeyGen developer portal at developers.heygen.com (docs.heygen.com redirects there). 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Avatar Realtime API」，加上厂商名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.heygen.com/blog/heygen-june-2026-release 首次公开日期仅精确到月。
